flashpoints.title: A cheap model wipes $589B off NVIDIA
flashpoints.mechanism: A lab with a pre-control stock of A100s trained V3 in 2.788M H800 GPU hours, showing capital is not the only way in.
flashpoints.outcome: NVIDIA lost over $589B in a day, yet DeepSeek was later valued at $52B and relies on Huawei chips.

flashpoints.title: Defection builds a rival
flashpoints.mechanism: Eleven OpenAI staff left to found Anthropic; its 80% two-year retention then pulled engineers from OpenAI and DeepMind, while Amazon, Google and NVIDIA funded the compute.

flashpoints.title: Custom silicon presses on NVIDIA
flashpoints.mechanism: Customers with their own balance sheets contract TPUs, Trainium, Broadcom designs, Maia and MTIA to cut dependence on NVIDIA; AMD paid OpenAI with a warrant.
flashpoints.outcome: Google plans 4.3M TPUs in 2026; Amazon holds over $225B of Trainium commitments; Rainier has nearly 500,000 Trainium2; OpenAI signed 10 GW with Broadcom; Meta rents TPUs.

flashpoints.title: The best coding entrant is absorbed
flashpoints.advantage: capital and a model owner's balance sheet
flashpoints.mechanism: Cursor reached $29.3B and $3B ARR against GitHub Copilot, then became a SpaceXAI subsidiary.
flashpoints.outcome: Acquired and integrated from June 2026; wholly owned from August.
